choices.text: Every artery carries oxygenated blood, without exception
The pulmonary artery carries oxygenated blood because it is an artery
The pulmonary artery carries deoxygenated blood from the heart to the lungs
The pulmonary artery is really a vein because its blood is oxygen-poor

questions.explanation: The trap claim is: Arteries always carry oxygenated blood. In fact The pulmonary artery is the exception: it carries deoxygenated blood from the heart to the lungs. An artery is named by direction - away from the heart - not by the oxygen in its blood.
questions.prompt: Which statement about the pulmonary artery is correct?

choices.text: Xylem carries water up; phloem moves food from the leaves

questions.explanation: Xylem lifts water and minerals from roots to leaves; phloem shares food made in the leaves. Plants have no heart.
questions.prompt: Which pairing of plant transport tissues is correct?

questions.answer: The right side of the heart pumps oxygen-poor blood to the lungs along the pulmonary loop, where it loads oxygen. The left side pumps that oxygen-rich blood around the body along the systemic loop, where it unloads oxygen.
questions.explanation: One circuit, two loops, two passes through the heart: pulmonary loads oxygen, systemic delivers it.
questions.prompt: Explain the double circulation: what does each side of the heart pump, and where?

questions.answer: It is an artery because it carries blood away from the heart. Vessel names follow direction: arteries away from the heart, veins back towards it. Its blood is oxygen-poor because it is travelling to the lungs to collect oxygen.
questions.explanation: Direction defines the vessel, never the colour or oxygen level of the blood inside it.
questions.prompt: The pulmonary artery carries oxygen-poor blood. Explain why it is still called an artery.

choices.text: It carries blood back to the heart
It pumps oxygen-rich blood from the left side of the heart to the body
It pumps blood only to the lungs
It makes blood in its walls

questions.explanation: The left side is the body pump of the double circulation; the right side serves the lungs.
questions.prompt: What is the job of the left side of the heart?
